summary: Sandbach United faced Widnes Town in a local league fixture on August 29th, with the hosts dealing with wet conditions at The Bach but remaining positive about the playing surface. The club encouraged supporters to attend with affordable admission prices ranging from £2 for under-16s to £6 for adults, emphasizing how much the team values fan backing. This matchday came during an active period for NWCFL sides, with several clubs competing in cup competitions alongside their regular league fixtures.
